name: replay-mcp
stderr:
[ReplayMCP] TRACES_DIR: /tmp/.replay-mcp/traces
Usage:
  replay-mcp --target <command> [args...]
  replay-mcp --target-url <url>

Tokens are resolved automatically from OpenCode's mcp-auth.json.
The UI dashboard auto-starts at http://localhost:4242.

Options:
  --header "Key: Value"  Custom HTTP header (repeatable)
  --env-token            Use REPLAY_MCP_TOKEN env var as Bearer token
  --no-auto-auth         Disable automatic token resolution
  --no-auto-ui           Disable auto-starting the UI dashboard

Examples:
  replay-mcp --target /usr/local/bin/playwright-mcp
  replay-mcp --target-url https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp
  replay-mcp --target-url https://gitlab.com/api/v4/mcp
